what: The floating Back to top button appears with .3s ease-out only after the page has scrolled down 500px, and disappears over the same length when scrolling back above that

options.at: Appear scroll position — px number or a screen-height ratio like ”100vh”, default 500
options.--fx-dur: Duration of appearing and disappearing (via style), default .3s
options.is-shown: Marker attached to the element while visible
options.look: drop: When hidden, sits offset upward by --fx-y, then drops in together with opacity (late-dropping header line)
options.--fx-y: Hidden position for drop Type (via style), default -2rem
options.once: If true, once it has appeared it does not hide again when scrolled back up (by default it toggles on and off each time it moves up and down past its position)
options.key: Name for recording what was closed in the session — [data-fx-part=Pressing close] hides it, and it does not show again while this name exists
options.look: slide: While hidden it sits off to the right (--fx-x, default calc(100% + 10px)) and slides in when shown. When hiding, visibility switches off late by --fx-hide-delay (default .2s)
options.[data-fx-part=close]: (If present) close button — when pressed it hides and is not measured again
options.look: drop-solid: Like drop it waits above --fx-y then comes down but does not turn transparent — a fixed pill menu hidden off screen (presses blocked while hidden)
options.after: CSS selector — if given, it appears once you scroll past the bottom of that element (document-based) instead of at. Re-measured when the window resizes (xn-brand: fixed menu bar after passing the hero .xm-hero or the subpage header .xm-pttl)
options.look: slide-solid: Like slide, it waits outside at --fx-x and slides in, but does not turn transparent — vertical text on both sides of the screen (xn-brand: left --fx-x: calc(-100% - 2.92vw) · right calc(100% + 2.92vw) · .4s ease-out)
options.look: rise: While hidden it rests --fx-y (default 200px) below, then rises with a fade in (--fx-dur, --fx-ease), and on hiding it switches off at once with no transition — Brand LINE badge .3s linear
options.edge: If bottom, it appears when the bottom edge of the screen reaches the at position (original ”scrollTop >= 1720 - window height) — default is the top edge of the screen
